verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
LABA-emmeeza yange
Nga-ejjudde ebya ssava;
Mujje ku mbaga-eno
Mulye-emmere y'obulamu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Alina ennyonta
N'enjala ng'emuluma;
Ajje mangu gye ndi
Nange naamuliisanga.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Nze mmere ennungi
Kitange gye yabawa;
Ereetera ensi
Obulamu-obutaggwaawo.
